content.query:
select
COUNT(*),
CAST(CURRENT_EOD_DATE AS DATE) CURRENT_EOD_DATE,
CAST(cast(YTD_Business_Date as varchar) AS DATE) YTD_Business_Date
FROM 
EDS.DEPOSIT_FACT
WHERE
CAST(CURRENT_EOD_DATE AS DATE)>CAST(cast(YTD_Business_Date as varchar) AS DATE)
GROUP BY
CAST(CURRENT_EOD_DATE AS DATE),
CAST(cast(YTD_Business_Date as varchar) AS DATE)
